modmenu.summaryTranslation.dropped_item_: Follow a dropped item with a steady camera.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dropped_i:
Follow a dropped item with a steady camera.

Aim at a visible dropped item within 32 blocks and press V. Following starts in rear third-person view. F5 cycles rear, front and first-person views. Move the mouse to look around. Camera angles stay independent of the item's spin.

Press V again to return. Following ends when the item disappears, including pickup, despawn or merging into another stack. Your previous perspective is restored. Change the follow key in Options > Controls > Key Binds > Dropped Item Camera.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric. Requires Fabric API. Install on the client. Tracking uses entities loaded by your client.
